module.purpose: Defines the image shape utility and its rendering, geometry, resizing, cropping, animation, export, and asset-handling behavior for the tldraw editor.
module.summary: This module integrates image assets with the editor's shape system. It supplies image shape defaults, geometry that accounts for transparency and circular crops, resize-time crop mirroring, SVG export with asset URL resolution and animated-image frame extraction, and crop-editing interactions. Its React rendering path handles missing assets, asynchronous image loading, reduced-motion previews, alpha-data preloading, hyperlinks, cropping, and horizontal or vertical flips.
module.businessContext: Supports image insertion, editing, accessibility, and export in collaborative whiteboard documents. Failures can break image display, cropping, animation behavior, or document export.
